approach.heading: Small enough to move quickly. Structured enough to be useful.

steps.title: Scope
steps.copy: Confirm the exact SKU, quantity, term, agency, set-aside, and submission rule before quoting.

steps.title: Source
steps.copy: Work through authorized distributors and capture the program, level, and quote-validity assumptions.

steps.title: Submit
steps.copy: Package the quote with clear line items, certifications, representations, and contact details.

contact.heading: Send a procurement or teaming request.
contact.copy: Include the solicitation number, required products, submission deadline, and whether you need prime or subcontract support.
